question.text:
Match List - I with List - II.
\(\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}
\hline & \text { (Test) } & & \text { (Identification) } \\
\hline \text { (A) } & \text { Bayer's test MARKS } & \text { (I) } & \text { Phenol VIARKS } \\
\hline \text { (B) } & \text { Ceric ammonium nitrate test } & \text { (II) } & \text { Aldehyde } \\
\hline \text { (C) } & \text { Phthalein dye test } R \mathrm{~K} & \text { (III) } & \text { Alcoholic-OH group } \\
\hline \text { (D) } & \text { Schiff's test } & \text { (IV) } & \text { Unsaturation } \\
\hline
\end{array}\)
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :

solution.text:
(A) Bayer's test $\rightarrow$ Unsaturation
(B) Ceric ammonium nitrate test $\rightarrow$ Alcoholic-OH group
(C) Phthalein dye test $\rightarrow$ Phenol
(D) Schiff's test $\rightarrow$ Aldehyde
